faq_heading: Port Coquitlam Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Port Coquitlam townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in Port Coquitlam was $834,300 in September 2026 (-7.8% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Port Coquitlam townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

155 townhomes sold in Port Coquitlam with a median price of $878,000 (the middle half sold between $800,000 and $1,000,000), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $557 per square foot, a median year built of 2002 and a median strata fee of $407 a month.

Townhomes against other home types in Port Coquitlam

Port Coquitlam: the townhomes benchmark of $834,300 sits $406,300 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,240,600 (67% of it) and $284,300 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $550,000 (152% of it).

items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: What did townhomes in Port Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 155 townhomes sold in Port Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $878,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Port Coquitlam sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 155 townhomes that sold in Port Coquitlam went for between $800,000 and $1,000,000, around a median of $878,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Port Coquitlam sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 155 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.9% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Of the 155 sales, 153 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $407.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median year built was 2002 for the 155 townhomes sold in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Port Coquitlam usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Port Coquitlam had 3 bedrooms, from the 155 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Coquitlam communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Riverwood (66), Citadel PQ (31), Central Pt Coquitlam (24), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Port Coquitlam was $834,300 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 7.8%. Over three months it fell 4.9%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Port Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Port Coquitlam that match what you want.
